item.title: Rio Grande Valley leaders upbeat about economy despite maquiladora layoffs
item.description: As hundreds of people from both sides of the border gathered for the MXLAN International Economic Summit on Friday in McAllen, news filtered about 600 job losses in Brownsville by a Mexican-based maquiladora. But officials tell Border Report that job gains in the Rio Grande Valley offset these losses. And they say automation, A-I and jobs involving new technology are the future driving the region.
